title: Rank completed groups
brief: Rank grouped results instead of individual detail rows.
instructions: Return all paid UTC 2024 monthly category transaction totals and competition rank within each month. Do not apply a rank cutoff. Sort month then rank; peer order is free.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving rank completed groups.

hints.text: Aggregate to monthly category grain before applying a window rank.
Put totals in a named relation; rank revenue descending within month in the outer query.
Equal January totals share ranks 1 and 3, followed by rank 5.
